repos.description: Odoo. Open Source Apps To Grow Your Business.
repos.summary_zh: Odoo 是一套基于开源技术的企业级业务应用套件，涵盖 CRM、电商、仓储、财务、项目管理等核心模块，支持模块化部署与无缝集成，提供完整的开源 ERP 解决方案。其低代码平台与 Python 技术栈便于二次开发，适用于中小企业数字化转型。
repos.summary_en: Odoo is an open-source business application suite featuring integrated modules like CRM, eCommerce, accounting, and inventory management. Built on Python, it offers modular, scalable ERP solutions with seamless integration and extensive customization capabilities for growing businesses.

repos.description: 定投改变命运 —— 让时间陪你慢慢变富 https://onregularinvesting.com
repos.summary_zh: 《定投改变命运》系统阐述普通人通过定期投资实现财富积累与阶层跃迁的路径，强调定投作为唯一可操作、可坚持的长期投资策略，结合证券市场奇迹属性与人性弱点分析，提供可落地的投资哲学与实践指南。
repos.summary_en: This book systematically explains how ordinary people can break through class barriers through regular investing, emphasizing that dollar-cost averaging is the only feasible and sustainable investment strategy. It combines market insights with human psychology to offer a practical philosophy and actionable guidance for long-term wealth building.

repos.summary_zh: kafka-python 是一个功能完整的 Python 客户端库，用于与 Apache Kafka 分布式流处理系统交互。它高度模拟官方 Java 客户端的行为，支持高吞吐量的消息生产与消费，提供消费者组、偏移量提交、事务消息、消息头、反序列化等高级功能，适用于构建实时数据管道和流处理应用。
repos.summary_en: kafka-python is a fully-featured Python client for Apache Kafka, designed to closely mimic the official Java client. It supports high-level asynchronous message production and consumption, consumer groups, offset commits, transactional messages, message headers, and deserialization, making it ideal for building real-time data pipelines and streaming applications.

repos.description: XIAOJUSURVEY is an enterprises form builder and analytics platform that allows users to create questionnaires, exams, polls, quizzes, and analyze data online.
repos.summary_zh: XIAOJUSURVEY 是一套企业级表单构建与数据分析平台，支持问卷、考试、投票等多样化调研场景。基于 Vue3 + NestJS 技术栈，提供 40+ 题型、100+ 模板，具备智能逻辑编排、AI 生成问卷、分题统计与交叉分析能力，支持品牌化定制与多端嵌入，适用于市场调研、客户满意度测评等复杂业务场景。
repos.summary_en: XIAOJUSURVEY is an enterprise-grade form builder and analytics platform enabling creation of questionnaires, exams, polls, and quizzes with online data analysis. Built on Vue3 + NestJS, it offers 40+ question types, 100+ templates, AI-powered survey generation, logic rules, cross-analysis, and brand customization for market research, customer feedback, and educational assessments.

repos.description: outlookEmail 支持 Outlook/Hotmail、Gmail、QQ、163、126、Yahoo、阿里邮箱以及自定义 IMAP 邮箱，同时集成 GPTMail、DuckMail、Cloudflare Temp Email 多提供商临时邮箱能力
repos.summary_zh: 多邮箱邮件管理工具，支持 Outlook OAuth、Microsoft Graph API 和 IMAP 协议统一读取管理 Outlook/Gmail/QQ/163/Yahoo 等主流邮箱，提供 Web 界面实现分组代理、别名转发、临时邮箱集成及对外 API 调用，具备缓存优化、批量操作和安全防护能力。
repos.summary_en: Multi-email management tool supporting Outlook OAuth, Microsoft Graph API and IMAP protocols to unify access to Outlook/Gmail/QQ/163/Yahoo accounts. Features web interface for group-based proxy routing, alias forwarding, temporary email integration, and external API with caching, batch operations, and security protections.

repos.description: Resume template for Coder 适合程序员的简历模板 🎉
repos.summary_zh: 专为程序员设计的简历模板，基于Sketch.app制作，提供多版本（2021/2019/2018/2017/中文版）设计，突出技术能力与项目经验，支持一键导出PDF，适配不同求职场景。
repos.summary_en: A professional resume template designed for coders, built with Sketch.app. Offers multiple versions (2021/2019/2018/2017/Chinese) to showcase technical skills and project experience, with one-click PDF export for job applications.

repos.summary_zh: Yarb 是一个每日资讯聚合工具，整合36氪、知乎日报、雪球等主流内容源，提供科技、产品、投资等领域精选文章与热点话题，帮助用户高效获取一手信息。
repos.summary_en: Yarb is a daily news aggregator that curates content from sources like 36Kr, Zhihu Daily, and Xueqiu, delivering curated tech, product, and investment insights to help users stay informed efficiently.
